FIELDS.NAME: Sunrise Medical and Dental Center
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Dr. Lisa Thompson, Director of Operations, 555-123-4567, lisa.thompson@sunrisemedical.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Sunrise Medical and Dental Center, we provide comprehensive healthcare services that encompass both medical and dental practices. Our operations include preventive care, diagnostics, treatment services, and patient education, all delivered by licensed healthcare professionals. We prioritize patient safety and adhere strictly to state and federal regulations, ensuring all healthcare staff maintain current licenses and certifications. Our facility is equipped with modern technology and adheres to best practices for infection control and hazardous material management, with documented employee training on these procedures to mitigate risks. We emphasize secure storage for patient records in compliance with privacy regulations. Our appointment scheduling system is structured to optimize patient flow and minimize waiting times, contributing to a better patient experience. Additionally, our proactive risk management protocols include regular assessments and compliance reviews to sustain our operational integrity and commitment to high-quality care.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/10/2023, a minor water leak due to a malfunctioning air conditioning unit resulted in damage to the flooring and some medical equipment, leading to repair expenses totaling $3,200. The damage was promptly addressed, and the situation has since been resolved with no ongoing issues.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class II, Grade 1, Secure Vault for Medical and Dental Records
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the perimeter of the property to enhance safety and deter unauthorized access.
